description: Cuts a signal off at an upper and a lower threshold, or folds it back at them, adding harmonics either way

params.text: Scales the voltage at the upper threshold jack before it is added to the upper threshold knob, 0 to 1
Scales the voltage at the lower threshold jack before it is added to the lower threshold knob, 0 to 1
Sets the level above which the signal is cut or folded; the knob reads 0 to 5V and in the unipolar setting 5V is added to it, giving 5 to 10V
Sets the level below which the signal is cut or folded; the knob reads -5V to 0V and in the unipolar setting 5V is added to it, giving 0 to 5V

inputs.text: The signal to be clipped or folded, in as many polyphonic channels as the cable carries
Added to the upper threshold knob after its attenuator; while this jack is patched the unipolar setting's 5V offset is dropped and the total is held at or above 5V instead
Added to the lower threshold knob after its attenuator; while this jack is patched the unipolar setting's 5V offset is dropped and the total is held at or below 5V instead

outputs.text: Carries the clipped or folded signal at the same number of polyphonic channels as the input

notes: clipping and folding both take level off the signal and nothing puts it back, so an amplifier or a mixer after this module is usually wanted
the modulation jacks are read one channel at a time and the same threshold is applied to every polyphonic channel
nothing is computed unless both the input and the output are patched
the two threshold knobs both read Volt in Rack's own tooltip, and neither shows the 5V the unipolar setting adds
the lower threshold attenuator is named Attenuation for Upper Threshold Modulation in Rack's tooltip; the source names both attenuators the same
menu: Clip Method: Clip, Fold — chooses whether a signal past a threshold is held at the threshold or reflected back from it by the amount it overshot
Polarity: Unipolar (0..10V), Bipolar (-5V..5V) — chooses which voltage range the two threshold knobs cover; the unipolar setting adds 5V to each knob's reading

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
